description: Restore HP to a character. Capped at max HP. Use for any HP recovery (rest, spell, potion narration, GM fiat). In worlds with Health and Wounds, `wounds` treats Wounds (e.g. medical care).

amount.description: Amount of HP (Health) to restore. Capped at the character's max HP.

wounds.description: Wounds to treat, in worlds with Health and Wounds (never below 0)

name: heal_character
